title: Palestinian Family Forced to Demolish Own Jerusalem Home as Demolitions Surpass 11,600
detail: A Palestinian family in Jerusalem was compelled by Israeli authorities to demolish their own home, a practice used to avoid the higher costs of state-enforced demolition. The incident comes as Israeli-ordered property demolitions in the occupied Palestinian territories have surpassed 11,600 structures, marking a significant threshold in the ongoing policy of home demolitions that affects Palestinian communities across East Jerusalem and the West Bank.

title: Syrian Families Publicly Demand Release of Relatives Detained by Israel
detail: Syrian families held a public demonstration demanding the release of their relatives who have been detained by Israel, highlighting cross-border detention dynamics in the aftermath of the October 7 conflict and Israel's expanded military operations. The families' public appeal underscores the ongoing humanitarian concerns around Israeli detention practices extending beyond Palestinian territories into Syria.
